diagnosis: PolicyTranslationHistoryView displays the revision history of translated compliance clauses. The query TranslatedPolicyAuditLog.objects.filter(policy_id=policy_id, ...) filters by policy_id and translation field name, but fails to check whether request.user belongs to the organization that owns the policy. An attacker can inspect proprietary legal policy revisions and internal compliance changes of other enterprises.

GET /policies/audit/733/?lang=de HTTP/1.1
Host: compliance.grcportal.com
Cookie: sessionid=active_user_session
Accept: application/json
